US Supreme Court Ruling on Birthright Citizenship

The US Supreme Court has ruled that the birthright citizenship provision in the 14th Amendment to the US Constitution is unconstitutional. This ruling affects the citizenship status of children born abroad to US citizens, potentially impacting their access to benefits and rights. The decision was made by a conservative majority on the court, with some justices dissenting from the outcome.
